Our Story

A private estate above the clouds

High in Gohtong Jaya, where the air turns cool and the pines hold the morning mist, a heritage Mansion looks out over the Awana valley and the rainforest beyond. Once known as Puncak Dani, the estate has been carefully restored and reborn as Dani Hill.

We host just one wedding a day. On your date, the house, the gardens and the views belong only to you — arrive through the Tunnel of Trees, say your vows on the lawn beneath the pines, and dance in the Mansion as the mist rolls in.

A Heritage Mansion

A restored European-style house with a grand staircase and chandeliers — a romantic backdrop inside and out.

Highland Views

Overlooking the Awana Golf & Country Club and the rainforest, with gardens framed by pines and hills.

Truly Private

We host one wedding a day, so the whole estate — house, gardens and views — is reserved for you.

Cool Mountain Air

Typically 18–22°C, with soft mist in the mornings and evenings — no city heat on your big day.

Your Own Team

A venue-only estate: bring the planner, caterer and decorator you trust, or ask for our recommendations.

Stay the Night

The Mansion and Villa Dani sleep up to 30 family and friends — wake to breakfast in the mist.

*Celebrations above 300 guests carry a surcharge. Indoor alternatives available for every outdoor plan.
